sentences.en: The little girl was absorbed in reading a fairy tale.
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩沉浸在童话故事中。

sentences.en: A man who is absorbed in his work looks animated.
sentences.zh: 一个专注于工作的男人看起来很有活力。

sentences.en: I can't absorb all of the lesson in an hour.
sentences.zh: 我一小时内无法消化完这堂课的内容。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ab（离去）+sorb（吸收）→吸收掉→吸收
